raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# What does this PR do ?

Switch the GPT-OSS 120B BF16 B200 and B300 perf recipes to the NCCL EP flex dispatcher, following the NCCL EP move already made for the GB200/GB300 MoE recipes.

# Changelog

- `perf_recipes/gpt_oss/b300/gpt_oss.py` (`gpt_oss_120b_pretrain_64gpu_b300_bf16_config`): HybridEP → NCCL EP via `_enable_ncclep`, keep `moe_use_grouped_tensor=True`, add `NCCL_EP_HT_EM_PULL_PUSH=1`, drop the four HybridEP topology variables.
- `perf_recipes/gpt_oss/b200/gpt_oss.py` (`gpt_oss_120b_pretrain_64gpu_b200_bf16_config`): alltoall → NCCL EP via `_enable_ncclep`, `moe_use_grouped_tensor=False` (faster on this eager, no-CUDA-graph recipe), add `NCCL_EP_HT_EM_PULL_PUSH=1`.
- New `tests/unit_tests/recipes/test_gpt_oss_nvl8_ncclep_perf_recipes.py`: both recipes use flex + ncclep, EP=8, pull/push on, no HybridEP variables, and the per-GPU grouped-tensor setting.

Pull/push mode is valid because EP=8 keeps every EP group inside one NVL8 domain; the test pins EP=8 so a later EP change has to revisit it.

# Performance

64 GPUs, BF16, mean iteration time over iterations 30–44.

**B200, internal CI (nightly image), MBridge `main` vs this PR:**

| | Dispatcher | Iteration time | TFLOPS/GPU |
|---|---|---|---|
| `main` (4f02f0fa0) | alltoall | 5,747 ms | 465.2 |
| this PR (ec1e287e1) | NCCL EP | 6,015 ms | 444.8 |

Both runs complete training. Both trip the CI performance check as an *improvement* against the stored B200 golden values, which are older than both; those goldens need a refresh after merge.

**Dispatcher A/B (NeMo 26.10 RC image, one or two runs per arm, runs within an arm agree within 0.8%):**

| | B300 | B200 cluster 1 | B200 cluster 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| alltoall | — | 5,858 ms | 5,719 ms |
| flex + HybridEP | 4,986 ms | 6,099 ms (+4.1%) | — |
| NCCL EP, grouped tensors on | 5,016 ms (+0.6%) | 6,245 ms (+6.6%) | 6,081 ms (+6.3%) |
| **NCCL EP, grouped tensors off (B200 in this PR)** | — | **6,154 ms (+5.1%)** | **6,028 ms (+5.4%)** |
| NCCL EP, pull/push off | — | 6,449 ms (+10.1%) | 6,300 ms (+10.2%) |

- **B300:** NCCL EP is at parity with HybridEP.
- **B200:** NCCL EP is ~5% slower than the current alltoall recipe. About 4 points of that come from moving this eager recipe onto the flex dispatch path at all (HybridEP pays it too); NCCL EP vs HybridEP is +0.9% with grouped tensors off.
- Pull/push off is clearly slower, so it stays on.

The B300 numbers come from benchmark runs outside CI: CI currently has no B300 cluster to run the B300 test on.

# GitHub Actions CI

See the [CI section](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#-running-github-ci) in the Contributing doc for how to trigger the CI. A Nvidia developer will need to approve and trigger the CI for external contributors.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [x] Make sure you read and followed [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Did you write any new necessary tests?
- [ ] Did you add or update any necessary documentation? (not needed: recipe defaults only)
- [ ] Does the PR affect components that are optional to install? (Ex: Numba, Pynini, Apex etc) (no)
  - [ ] Reviewer: Does the PR have correct import guards for all optional libraries?

# Additional Information

- Please cherry-pick to `r0.7.0` (NeMo 26.10.01).
- Follow-ups: refresh the B200/B300 GPT-OSS golden values after merge. Pull/push is hard-coded on in the NVL8 NCCL EP recipes, so an EP override above 8 at launch time would need it turned off.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

 """B200 performance recipes for GPT-OSS."""
 
+from megatron.bridge.perf_recipes._common import _enable_ncclep
 from megatron.bridge.perf_recipes.environment import COMMON_PERF_ENV_VARS
 from megatron.bridge.perf_recipes.gpt_oss.common import (
     ConfigContainer,
@@ -23,7 +24,7 @@
 
 
 def gpt_oss_120b_pretrain_64gpu_b200_bf16_config() -> ConfigContainer:
-    """GPT-OSS 120B pretrain: 64× B200, BF16, GBS=1280."""
+    """GPT-OSS 120B pretrain: 64× B200, BF16, GBS=1280, NCCL EP."""
     cfg = gpt_oss_120b_pretrain_config()
     cfg.mixed_precision = _perf_precision("bf16")
     cfg.model.moe_router_fusion = True
@@ -40,6 +41,9 @@ def gpt_oss_120b_pretrain_64gpu_b200_bf16_config() -> ConfigContainer:
     cfg.model.recompute_granularity = "selective"
 
     _benchmark_common(cfg)
+    _enable_ncclep(cfg)
+    # Grouped tensors ran slower on this eager (no CUDA graph) BF16 recipe, so keep the default grouped MLP path.
+    cfg.model.moe_use_grouped_tensor = False
     # Keep process settings next to the recipe so users can see the exact benchmark environment.
     cfg.env_vars = {
         **COMMON_PERF_ENV_VARS,
@@ -51,6 +55,8 @@ def gpt_oss_120b_pretrain_64gpu_b200_bf16_config() -> ConfigContainer:
         "TORCH_NCCL_AVOID_RECORD_STREAMS": 1,
         # NCCL user-buffer and launch settings.
         "NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE": 0,

+        "NCCL_EP_HT_EM_PULL_PUSH": 1,
         # Transformer Engine overlap settings for this model.

 def gpt_oss_120b_pretrain_64gpu_b300_bf16_config() -> ConfigContainer:

+#

+# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+# You may obtain a copy of the License at

+#     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

+# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+# limitations under the License.
+"""The GPT-OSS 120B BF16 B200 and B300 perf recipes run NCCL EP with each EP8 group inside one NVL8 domain."""
+
+import importlib
+
+import pytest
+
+from megatron.bridge.perf_recipes.environment import HYBRID_EP_ENV_NAMES
+from tests.unit_tests.recipes.recipe_test_utils import patch_recipe_construction_dependencies
+
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit
+
+# (module under megatron.bridge.perf_recipes, recipe factory, expected moe_use_grouped_tensor).
+# B300 runs TE CUDA graphs and keeps grouped tensors; the eager B200 recipe was slower with them.
+_GPT_OSS_NVL8_NCCLEP_RECIPES = (
+    ("gpt_oss.b200.gpt_oss", "gpt_oss_120b_pretrain_64gpu_b200_bf16_config", False),
+    ("gpt_oss.b300.gpt_oss", "gpt_oss_120b_pretrain_64gpu_b300_bf16_config", True),
+)
+
+# Import at collection time: the offline-construction fixture patches ``AutoBridge`` in every recipe module
+# that is already loaded, so a lazy import inside a test would escape the patch.
+_RECIPE_MODULES = {
+    module_name: importlib.import_module(f"megatron.bridge.perf_recipes.{module_name}")
+    for module_name, _, _ in _GPT_OSS_NVL8_NCCLEP_RECIPES
+}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _keep_recipe_construction_offline(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    patch_recipe_construction_dependencies(monkeypatch)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("module_name", "factory_name", "grouped_tensor"), _GPT_OSS_NVL8_NCCLEP_RECIPES, ids=lambda value: str(value)
+)
+def test_gpt_oss_nvl8_bf16_recipes_use_nccl_ep(module_name: str, factory_name: str, grouped_tensor: bool) -> None:
+    cfg = getattr(_RECIPE_MODULES[module_name], factory_name)()
+
+    assert cfg.model.moe_token_dispatcher_type == "flex"
+    assert cfg.model.moe_flex_dispatcher_backend == "ncclep"
+    assert cfg.model.moe_use_grouped_tensor is grouped_tensor
+    # Pull/push mode is only valid while each EP group stays inside one NVL8 domain.
+    assert cfg.model.expert_model_parallel_size == 8
+    assert cfg.env_vars["NCCL_EP_HT_EM_PULL_PUSH"] == 1
+    assert cfg.env_vars.keys().isdisjoint(HYBRID_EP_ENV_NAMES)
